observedAdminAuthentication: Root reports owner authenticated through normal Admin UI; this agent did not access credentials or session state.

objective.vi: Kiểm tra liệu mode tổng hợp decision_next_step có giúp kết vòng bằng một bước tự quan sát nhỏ, cụ thể, phù hợp câu hỏi. Đây chỉ là gợi ý enum; không phải một prompt hướng dẫn đã nối runtime.
objective.en: Test whether decision_next_step synthesis encourages one specific question-relevant observation step. This is an enum hint, not a wired instruction prompt.

noPromptTextControl: The current Council system prompt is hardcoded in ai-council/index.ts. No existing Council Builder text field can enforce grounding, one tiny experiment, independent guide methods, or a trust style through that system prompt.

runtimeDeliveryGate.problem: The mobile request sends the static bundled configVersion. Server filters active database config by that exact version. Publishing a fresh unique version archives the old active version; a request still pinned to the old version then falls back to its mobile template payload.
runtimeDeliveryGate.sameVersionRepublish: Not supported by current insert publisher; migration defines version UNIQUE. Do not bypass this by direct database edits.
runtimeDeliveryGate.requiredEvidence: A normal app request must resolve the intended active version with configSource supabase_active_config and the exact candidate template fields. Admin publish success/readback alone is insufficient.

publisherRisks: Publish performs separate config insert, template insert, active archive and new promotion calls; it is not an atomic transaction or optimistic concurrency compare-and-swap in reviewed source.
Failure after archiving and before promoting can leave no active config. Concurrent publishers can race.
A fresh-version rollback through the same publisher still has the mobile version-pin problem. No protected UI activate-prior operation was found in this reviewed endpoint.
whyNoReadyRequest: The actual active Admin payload has not been read by this agent and runtime delivery is blocked. Copying a seed-derived full payload would risk overwriting the owner configuration and would not prove any app behavior change.
prerequisites: Capture complete current Admin config/templates and current app build/version through authorized visible UI or normal protected read transport.
Compare actual loaded synthesisMode; if it already equals decision_next_step, there is no proposed change.

Resolve the client version pin using a reviewed feature slice or demonstrate an existing legitimate normal UI delivery path. Do not extract tokens or call a hidden inference path to label it an app test.
Establish an atomic publish/rollback path and preserve the previous complete payload before live promotion.
Keep model, roster, response schema, safety boundaries and unrelated templates fixed for any comparison.
Do not run database push or repair while the migration ledger gate is blocked.
managerTestAfterDeliveryPrerequisites: Open a fresh Council love_confusion room and use fictional C01; record current UI answer and trace configSource/configVersion before editing.
In existing Council Builder change only synthesis mode to decision_next_step; review the full loaded payload and authorized publish path.
Reload Admin and run the same prompt in a fresh normal app room; confirm trace uses the candidate version and mode, not mobile_payload.
Inspect assumptions, agency, distinct guide lenses, a useful synthesis and exactly one feasible small next step. Confirm no cards, facts or other person's motives are invented.
A provider fallback, model parser repair, absent provenance or failed UI rendering is not a successful quality comparison.
